summary: Create ML trains Core ML models (image, video, text, sound, motion and tabular) on the Mac, using Apple's ML toolchain and playgrounds. BifrOSt has no model training tool and no Core ML equivalent, and a desktop shell has no sensible counterpart for an Apple-only training pipeline.

features.note: image classifier training is tied to the Core ML toolchain
the keyboard word predictor (springboard/apps/keyboard/src/predict.rs) is a word list, not a trained model
no audio or motion model training
no tabular training API; the SDK has no data-table model
no evaluation metrics for trained models

gaps: No model training tool or training session API of any kind (none in springboard/sdk/src/ or springboard/ui/src/).
No Core ML model runtime for apps to load trained models; a desktop app that needs ML would ship its own runtime.
